submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole peaks on the token that supplies the strongly expected continuation of an already-established multi-token pattern, i.e. the low-surprisal element that resolves a frame the preceding ~30 tokens set up: the head word of a fixed term ('nonalcoholic fatty', 'light hair', 'sustainable methods', 'better guidance'), or the structurally required next piece of a code idiom ('object.set', 'switch ... case', '_size=letter', 'dbl>'). It is retrospective and needs the long preceding context; it does not fire on the same token when the frame does not predict it ('severe liver', 'sustainable targets', 'get_shape').
